newsitem.title: JAPAN: Joyo Bank falls ahead of 0630 GMT announcement.
newsitem.headline: Joyo Bank falls ahead of 0630 GMT announcement.

text.p: Shares in Joyo Bank Ltd fell on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Thursday afternoon ahead of an announcement by the bank at 3.30 p.m. (0630 GMT).
Japan's Jiji news agency reported that the announcement will be on losses incurred due to unspecified "improper" action within the bank.
Joyo said it would hold a news conference at that time but declined to comment on the topic or the Jiji report.
Shares in the Ibaraki-based bank had fallen 25 yen to 600 yen by 0423 GMT.
